declared_exclusions.item: Resource labels, expression-valued names, the 30 own-name types that map to no node type, attributes of nested blocks, and module-call arguments
declared_exclusions.reason: Stated in the limb's docstring from TF_LABEL_CENSUS.md sections 1, 3 and 4. A label is the state address, never an AWS name. An expression has no value before plan, so it is listed as 'unresolved before plan' (118 of 1266 at HEAD; row LGIC_ENFORCE-W3-S9). grade() has no node type for the 30 types. A nested-block attribute or a module argument is not the resource's own name.

declared_exclusions.item: .tf.json files and the resources of modules the root calls
declared_exclusions.reason: The order names DIR's .tf files. A called module is its own Terraform root, and its resources name themselves by var.<x>, an expression at the root.

declared_exclusions.item: A real plan passing the gates that run after the stage
declared_exclusions.reason: T2-AC2's run reached the stub terraform and then stopped at the tombstone gate (rc=3), because the stub writes no plan JSON. That gate is downstream of this cell's stage and outside its grant; the criterion asserts only that terraform is reached.

Control harnesses, not criterion carriers. No criterion of this order grades them; their outputs are recorded under controls.mutant and in rows W3-S6, W3-S8 and W3-S9. They are committed so that L9 can re-run them. Both write only under .scratch/ and move nothing live.
